## Generic CRM lead upsert v1.0
`testMode=true` is the default and bypasses every HTTP node.

- Configure an HTTPS API profile and OAuth2 credential in this workflow, never in caller input.
- The adapter contract expects `POST /leads/search`, `POST /leads`, and `PATCH /leads/{id}`.
- Omitted fields remain untouched; empty strings are rejected; clearing requires `clearFields`.
- More than one duplicate is fail-closed. Every mutable value needs non-LLM provenance.
